scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The breach tabletop begins
scenes.caption: Kabir leads a fictional data-exposure rehearsal. A public export link is confirmed in the supplied settings, while the full download scope remains unknown. The team must contain exposure, preserve evidence and communicate without inventing facts.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Roles before improvisation
scenes.caption: The incident lead coordinates and escalates, the authorised service operator changes access, the evidence recorder preserves supplied records and the communications lead sends approved factual updates. Students rehearse roles; they do not administer a real school system.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Contain and preserve
scenes.caption: Alert the responsible lead and retain available records. Use authorised controls to restrict the exposed link or session, record what changed and verify the restriction. Preserve evidence alongside urgent containment rather than delaying action for a perfect archive.
scenes.dialogue: Record the reason and time of each step.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose the first response
scenes.caption: Should the team erase logs to tidy the system, accuse the account holder in a group chat, or notify the authorised incident lead, preserve supplied records and restrict exposure through the operator?
scenes.dialogue: Containment and evidence can support each other.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: A factual stakeholder message
scenes.caption: The approved message states that a link was exposed and is now restricted, that scope is under review and where affected people can get help. It avoids naming a culprit or promising that no data was received.
scenes.dialogue: Communicate what is established and what remains under review.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the tabletop lab
scenes.caption: Assign the four roles, build the response order and choose a factual stakeholder update. Record the action log and handoff for recovery. This exercise sends no external message and changes no real service.
scenes.dialogue: Rehearse the response before an incident demands it.
